name: PrimaryNav - Derived Chapters
description: The header menu with the Chapters dropdown hovered open. None of the chapter links is authored in nav.json — they are generated from the chapters collection at render time, and they now sort active cities before forming ones, so a visitor meets the four places that hold events before the two asking for a lead. The dropdown closes with Global community, which is not a chapter at all: it points at the homepage band for everyone living nowhere near one of these cities. The other groups are the hand-authored ones an editor still edits under /admin, and they render identically, which is the point.
